proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.requires_linked_spell_sensor
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing grant_spell_access surface can restrict targeting relative to a spell sensor, but it cannot require that the granted cast be anchored to an active linked spell instance that provides that sensor.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor"

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.ends_when_linked_spell_ends
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface cannot express that an item-granted spell instance terminates when another linked spell instance ends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "it ends if the Scrying spell ends"

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.ignore_concentration
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface cannot override a granted spell's printed concentration requirement for casts made through a specific magic item grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration"

notes: No content file was authored. The item fits MagicItemRecord in principle, but encoding it today would falsely model Detect Thoughts as an independent normal spell grant instead of a Scrying-linked, concentration-overridden cast.
